rule: Typed receivers (decision A, all statically typed languages and typed PHP/Groovy declarations): a receiver whose type is given by a declaration — local, parameter, field/property (including `$var->prop` / `obj.field` chains whose property has a declared type), catch parameter, for-loop variable, pattern binding — or by `= new T(...)` gives `T#m` (high if defined in the scan, else medium). | Typing reaches only declarations in the scan: decision A and the parameterless-member rule use declared types written in the scanned source (including vendored code).
notes: Fields mu (sync.Mutex) and r (*strings.Reader) and the local `var sb strings.Builder` have declared types written in the scanned source, so calls on them name the external type (decision A, medium because the type is not defined in the scan). A deferred call (defer c.mu.Unlock()) and a goroutine call (go c.Add(2)) are ordinary calls on their lines; is_async is not compared. c.total += n is field access, not a call.
